summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release on new residential construction for August 2022, released September 20, 2022. Relevant to the task: This document provides the Not Seasonally Adjusted (NSA) housing starts (140.5 thousand) and completions (120.8 thousand) for August 2022, enabling the calculation of the starts-to-completions ratio for this initial month. It also supplies Seasonally Adjusted (SA) total units under construction for August 2022 (1,702 thousand) and July 2022 (1,676 thousand), necessary to compute the month-over-month growth rate required by the second criterion. While essential for evaluating August 2022, it covers only the first month of the 2022/08–2025/05 window and does not contain the full historical series needed to determine the top 20% growth threshold. Additionally, as an earlier release in the sequence, its data points are subject to potential revision by subsequent reports in the collection per the task's precedence rule.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release on new residential construction for September 2022.
